HOW IT WORKS

Six steps, start to placed.

It walks itself. Pick any step to stop it and look around.

STEP 01 · LIVECV

We set your institution up

We create your institution with a seat count dated to your academic year, then invite your placement officers by email. Each one lands in a portal scoped to your students only — nobody sees another college's roster.

STEP 02 · YOU

You upload the roster

A CSV or XLSX of up to 2,000 students, or paste rows straight in. Download the template if you would rather not guess the format. Students who already have a LiveCV account are linked, not duplicated.

STEP 03 · STUDENT

Students are invited and consent

Each student gets an email, activates their account, and gives versioned consent before anything of theirs is visible to you.

STEP 04 · YOU

You watch the roster fill in

Completeness and an advisory quality score per student, refreshed nightly. Open any consenting student to see exactly which sections are still thin.

STEP 05 · YOU

You shortlist and export

Filter by batch, course or score, then export exactly the rows you filtered to XLSX. Columns derived from a resume come back blank for a student who has not consented.

STEP 06 · RECRUITER

Recruiters open a link that expires

Share a shortlist as a link that lasts 7, 14 or 30 days, revocable at any time, that re-checks every student's consent each time it is opened.

CONSENT

Built so the student says yes first.

Indian placement cells hold a lot of student data and carry the risk personally. Consent here is a mechanism, not a checkbox.

01

Opt in, not opt out

A student's resume is invisible to your team until they consent, per institution, against a specific version of the terms.

02

Withdrawal actually works

A student who withdraws disappears from live shortlist links immediately. Exports you already downloaded are yours to handle, and we say so in the interface rather than pretending otherwise.

03

Consent-gated exports

Columns derived from a resume come back blank for a non-consenting student. The row still appears, marked, so nothing silently vanishes from your count.

04

Checked on every open, not once

A shortlist link re-resolves consent, enrolment and expiry each time a recruiter opens it. A link sent last week reflects the student's decision today.

What your students get.

Every student on your roster gets a permanent LiveCV profile: a Global ID and live resume links they keep for life, free, after they graduate and after your agreement with us ends. They choose which resume you see and can change it whenever they like.

Frequently asked questions

Who owns the student data?

The roster you upload is yours. The resume is the student's. Anything we derive from a resume, like a completeness or quality score, is computed under that student's consent and stops appearing in your dashboard and exports if they withdraw it.

What if a student refuses to consent?

They stay on your roster and still count against your seats. Their resume will not open and their quality columns export blank, with the row marked so you can see the gap rather than wondering where they went. They can consent later at any time.

Do students have to pay?

No. Every student on your roster keeps a permanent Global ID and live resume links for life, at no cost, including after they graduate and after your agreement with us ends. Whatever else your agreement grants applies while they are enrolled.

What happens at the end of the academic year?

Nothing automatic. We never suspend an institution or remove students on our own. When you are ready, you remove the batch that has graduated. Nobody loses their account or their identity when you do.

Is the quality score used to decide who gets placed?

No. It is advisory, and it exists so a student knows where to improve and an officer knows who to coach. It does not gate anyone from a drive, and we would not ship a single model call as a gate on someone's career.

How long does it take to get a college running?

The roster upload itself takes minutes. Realistically the time is students activating and consenting, which is why the dashboard shows you that funnel from day one.

Can we try it before committing?

Yes, that is what the pilot is for. Ask for a demo and we will talk about the shape that fits your batch size.
